title: TruthfulQA-Adversarial: A Red-Teamed Extension with Adversarially Constructed Distractor Answers

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Improving TruthfulQA distractors to be more model-plausible is a valid benchmark improvement. Impact is incremental: it makes an existing benchmark harder and more realistic, but does not reveal a fundamentally new safety insight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Using an LLM to generate plausible false answers and having annotators select the best ones is straightforward. Evaluation comparison on original vs adversarial versions uses standard tooling. Accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Generating adversarial distractors for 817 questions, human annotation, and evaluation comparison is a significant effort. Could be narrowed to a subset of categories, but as described covers the full benchmark.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
